name: runabout_i4_2l9_sv
source: Game engine for the Runabout T (racing_game, docs/new_cars_plan.md 3.1). Not a real engine: an [AS] 1910s-style 2.9 L side-valve (flathead) inline-four, one intake and one exhaust valve per cylinder in the block, a single updraft carburettor and a short cast exhaust manifold; class target about 15 kW at 1600 rpm and about 110 N*m low down (the 1909 car); this engine lands a little above it, like the later improved versions. Bore 95.25 x stroke 101.6 mm (3.75 x 4.00 in) x 4 = 2896 cm3 [AS, the period Model T geometry, recalled]; compression 4.0:1 [AS, period low-octane value - far below physics_sim's modern buildability band of 8-14.5, which the garage does not apply to stock engines]; every other number is [AS]. A side-valve chamber burns slowly: Wiebe burn duration 95 deg [AS] (60 is the modern default). Firing order 1-2-4-3. A heavy engine on a period 6 V starter: starter stall torque 220 N*m and free speed 420 rpm at the crank, start complete at 300 rpm; the idle valve may open to 25 % (high friction at idle) [AS]. Electronic throttle in the model; the hand throttle lever on the steering column feeds the same throttle channel. ECU: MBT tracking limited by the generated knock limit on E5 with a 2 deg margin (ignition_strategy knock_limited), stoichiometric part load, lambda 0.88 at full load. Measured with ps::drivetrain::run_dyno_sweep (wide-open throttle, warm, default installation, 2026-10-13): peak torque 135.2 N*m at 750 rpm, peak power 18.5 kW at 1550 rpm.

lambda_target.source: [AS] stoichiometric part load, power enrichment at wide-open throttle (lambda 0.88)

cycle.source: [AS] side-valve breathing: one 36.5 mm intake and one 36.5 mm exhaust valve, 236 deg duration, 6.35 mm (1/4 in) lift, IVO at TDC, EVO 45 BBDC, EVC 11 ATDC; big ports (300 cc) for the L-head passages and a discharge coefficient about 0.6x the overhead-valve curve (the flow turns twice through the pocket beside the bore) [AS]; a 24 mm updraft carburettor venturi as the throttle; friction mean effective pressure's constant term 200 kPa (3x the modern default: babbitt mains, splash oiling, heavy pistons, the flywheel magneto); 0.6 L manifold, 300 mm x 32 mm runners; 180 mm primaries paired 1+2 / 3+4. Assumed, not measured.

intake.source: [AS] 30 mm carburettor venturi as the throttle; friction mean effective pressure's constant term 200 kPa (3x the modern default: babbitt mains, splash oiling, heavy pistons, the flywheel magneto); 0.6 L manifold, 300 mm x 32 mm runners.

exhaust.source: [AS] short cast manifold: 180 mm x 35 mm primaries paired 1+2 and 3+4, 200 mm x 45 mm to the flange.

mass_source: ASSUMED [AS]: the period 2.9 L cast-iron side-valve four with its flywheel magneto weighs about 150-170 kg without the planetary gearbox (recalled, no citation fetched).
